standard_prerequisites.name: The derived category D(O_X) has direct sums and they are computed termwise on representatives
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the candidate direct sum in D(O_X).

standard_prerequisites.name: Taking direct sums is exact in any Grothendieck abelian category, so cohomology of a termwise direct sum is the direct sum of the cohomology sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the cohomology sheaves of the direct sum.

standard_prerequisites.name: A direct sum of quasi-coherent sheaves is quasi-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the direct sum lies in D_QCoh.

core_obligations: Existence of the ambient direct sums: by the injectives lemma D(O_X) has direct sums computed by termwise direct sums of representatives (proof lines 303-305).
Cohomology of the direct sum: since direct sums are exact in any Grothendieck abelian category, H^q of the termwise direct sum is the direct sum of the H^q (proof lines 306-308).
Conclusion: the direct sum of quasi-coherent sheaves is quasi-coherent by the schemes section, so the termwise direct sum is an object of D_QCoh and gives the direct sum there (proof lines 309-310).
proof_roadmap: Produce the termwise direct sum in D(O_X) (proof lines 303-305).
Conclude quasi-coherence and hence the direct sum in D_QCoh (proof lines 309-310).
